notes: Document D031 describes the Cambridge Tenants Rights and Resources Notification Ordinance (Cambridge Municipal Code Chapter 8.71). It is a disclosure and notice rule only. Landlords must hand tenants a rights and resources guide when a tenancy starts and when they take legal steps to end it (a notice to quit or summary process). The penalty is up to $300 per day of violation (§ 8.71.070). This is not a just-cause eviction rule. The FAQ says plainly: "This Ordinance does not prevent a landlord from initiating an eviction action if otherwise allowed by law." It also sets no rent cap, deposit rule, fee cap, screening limit or rule on rent-setting software. So nothing in this document fits the six categories, and no records were extracted. A reviewer may want to confirm that notification-only ordinances should stay out of scope.
